definition: be on your feet in an upright position
sentence: I stand by the door and wait.

definition: be on a chair or another seat
sentence: I sit by the window every morning.
usage: sit: be in a seated position

definition: move on foot at moderate pace
sentence: I like to walk through the peaceful park after dinner.

definition: move quickly on foot; also, a period of running
sentence: He runs five kilometers every day to stay fit.
usage: run in the park / go for a run / running as an activity
additionalExamples: I enjoy running in the park.
We go for a run after work.

definition: push off ground into air using legs
sentence: Children love to jump for joy when playing outside.

definition: spring on one foot
sentence: Can you hop across the room on your left foot?

definition: ascend using hands and feet
sentence: Be careful when you climb the wooden ladder.

definition: move forward on hands and knees
sentence: The baby is learning how to crawl on the soft mat.

definition: recline flat on back or side
sentence: Lie down on the bed if you feel dizzy.

definition: curve body forward from straight line
sentence: Bend forward and try to touch your toes.

definition: fall or rest on one or both knees
sentence: He knelt down on the grass to tie his sneaker.

definition: crouch low with knees bent
sentence: Squats are great exercises for strengthening legs.

definition: extend limbs or body to full length
sentence: Stretch your arms overhead after working for hours.

definition: rotate body 180 degrees
sentence: Turn around and look who is standing behind you!

definition: cease movement or activity
sentence: Stop when the traffic light turns red.

definition: drop down by gravity accidentally
sentence: Watch your step so you don't slip and fall.

definition: maintain steady body position on one foot
sentence: Try to balance on one leg with both arms open wide.

definition: move body rhythmically to music
sentence: They dance happily along with the cheerful music.

definition: move through water using your body; also, a period of swimming
sentence: I swim in the pool every week.
usage: swim in a pool / go for a swim / swimming as an activity

definition: engage in physical activity for fitness
sentence: Lifting dumbbells is a great way to exercise muscles.

definition: move from standing into a seat
sentence: Please sit down and make yourself at home.
usage: sit down: move into a seat

definition: rise to one's feet from seat
sentence: Everyone stood up when the anthem started playing.
usage: stand up: rise from a seat

definition: rest against a supporting surface
sentence: Do not lean against the glass wall for safety.

definition: stretch out arm to touch or grab
sentence: She reached up to take the book on the top shelf.

definition: lower and raise head in agreement
sentence: He nodded his head in agreement with the proposal.

definition: turn head side to side in disagreement
sentence: She shook her head to indicate that she disagreed.

definition: strike palms together loudly
sentence: The audience clapped enthusiastically after the concert.

definition: strike door with knuckles to signal
sentence: Always knock on the door before entering someone's room.

definition: move hands back and forth over surface
sentence: Rub your hands together to generate warm friction.

definition: rub skin with fingernails to relieve itch
sentence: Try not to scratch the itchy mosquito bite on your arm.

definition: expel air forcibly from lips
sentence: Blow on the pinwheel to make it spin fast.

definition: take air into lungs and expel it
sentence: Take a deep breath of the crisp morning air.

definition: expel air from lungs with sharp noise
sentence: Cover your mouth with your elbow when you cough.

definition: involuntarily expel air through nose and mouth
sentence: Use a tissue whenever you feel a sneeze coming on.

definition: cut into with teeth
sentence: Take a big juicy bite out of the crisp apple.

definition: crush food in mouth with teeth
sentence: Chew your food thoroughly before swallowing.

definition: pass food or drink down throat
sentence: Take a sip of water to help swallow the medicine pill.

definition: perceive scent through nose
sentence: Bend down to smell the fragrant blooming lily.

definition: perceive flavor with tongue
sentence: Taste the soup with a small spoon to check the salt.

definition: give food to baby or animal
sentence: The father feeds the smiling baby with warm puree.
